description.shortText: A robotic powered with machine vision that recognizes, sorts, picks, and processes debris for recycling. It helps in handling sudden shifts in waste volumes, but also makes the reuse of domestic and industrial waste more efficient by inserting leftover materials back into the supply chain.

attachments.name: AI In E-Waste Management: Dig Gold And Burn The Shit!
attachments.description:
Read this exciting story from Electronics For You May 2019.

The future of smart recycling is looking brighter. Robots, guided by cameras and artificial intelligence, are helping make recycling facilities run more efficiently

attachments.name: How artificial intelligence helps recycling become more circular
attachments.description: The process of sorting things for reuse gets faster and more specific.

attachments.name: Electronic Waste
attachments.description: The precision of AMP Cortex lends itself perfectly to the recovery requirements of electronic waste (e-waste). Cortex can identity, sort, and pick the smallest pieces of material to maximize the value recovered from material streams. Cortex can target and process a wide array of precious metals, components, plastics, and more.

attachments.name: Key factors of eddy current separation for recovering aluminum from crushed e-waste
attachments.description: Influencing mechanisms of feeding speed and Sp on separation efficiency of eddy current separation were provided.

attachments.name: AMP Robotics and Ryohshin partner on automation for construction recycling
attachments.description: AMP Robotics, a pioneer in artificial intelligence and robotics for the recycling industry, and waste management technology company Ryohshin are to make and sell AI-driven industrial robotics for material recovery in the Japanese construction and demolition market.

attachments.name: AMP Robotics launches new AI guided dual-robot system for recycling industry
attachments.description: AMP Robotics, a pioneer in artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics for the recycling industry, announced the launch of its new AMP Cortex dual-robot system (DRS) focused on material recovery in municipal solid waste (MSW), electronic waste (E-waste), and construction and demolition (C&D).

attachments.name: Robots Are Taking Over The Recycling Industry Because Of Pandemic
attachments.description: The coronavirus pandemic is transforming the relationship between humans and automation.
